profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer · C# / .NET · React / Next.js · AWS & Azure · APIs & integrations · AI-native · Built and run a profitable consumer-finance business solo (product, content, paid media) · Tampa / Remote
profile.summary:
Hands-on senior engineer, 15 years: C#/.NET, React/Next.js, AWS and Azure, and the integrations that move money and data between business systems. I also know what it takes to run a business end to end, because I run one.

Budget Sidekick is a consumer-finance business I built and operate alone, and most of the work isn't code. I own the strategy, the content, and the paid media:
• Content: 114 pages of mortgage and budgeting education and tools, all planned and written by me with an agentic workflow (Cursor and Claude, custom agents and skills)
• Paid media: Google Ads and Microsoft Ads strategy, campaign structure, bidding, keyword and landing-page testing, and the unit economics behind them; about $56k managed directly, profitable every quarter since launch
• Measurement: server-side conversion tracking and offline conversion upload for Google, Microsoft, and Reddit Ads with live ROAS reporting; partner reconciliation to the penny; QuickBooks invoicing
• Compliance: adheres to GLBA and CCPA with multi-state restrictions; bot and fraud detection built on network-intelligence data
• Results: 4,000+ leads generated for lending partners
• Stack: Next.js / TypeScript / PostgreSQL (Neon) on Vercel, plus an internal admin platform of about 40 modules

Before that:
• Roger West (Tampa agency), 2022–2026. The title was Director of IT; the job was hands-on engineering lead. Led four developers and outside vendors across 15+ enterprise accounts (Wellcare, Zing Health, Fleming's), built the agency's internal paid-media expense and budgeting apps in .NET Core and React, and integrated POS and CRM data (Toast, Olo, HubSpot, Pipedrive) into public-facing sites under HIPAA constraints.
• PODS, 2020–2022. Team lead for the migration of core services from WCF to ASP.NET Web API with OAuth 2.0; ASP.NET Core microservices, Elasticsearch logging, Azure DevOps CI/CD.
• ConnectWise, 2011–2020. Architected the move from a monolith to AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, and DynamoDB; built the ConnectWise Manage to QuickBooks Online invoice and payment integration; lead-distribution tooling syncing hundreds of thousands of records with Eloqua.

What I'm good at: taking a loosely defined business problem with regulatory constraints and shipping the system, the content, and the numbers behind it, then keeping all three running.

Open to senior, staff, and lead engineering roles (Tampa or remote) and to consulting through Primordial Software.

positions.title: Director of IT (Hands-on Engineering Lead)
positions.description:
Hands-on engineering lead for a full-service marketing agency serving Fortune 500 and S&P 500 clients. The title was Director of IT; day to day I was the senior engineer and team lead for the development group, writing code on every major account.
• Led four developers (senior and junior) and outsourcing vendors across 15+ client accounts; set coding standards and technical best practices, ran code review, reviewed contracts, and scoped and architected new sites, redesigns, maintenance retainers, and API integrations from stakeholder requirements
• Built the agency's internal operations software: paid-media expense tracking and operational budgeting applications on C#/.NET Core REST APIs and React; established the financial workflows and trained the team on them
• Delivered major enterprise accounts end to end (Fleming's Steakhouse, Wellcare/Centene, Zing Health), including HIPAA-compliant healthcare data integrations
• Designed and maintained multi-tier platform migrations integrating POS and CRM data (Toast, Olo, Menuology, HubSpot, Pipedrive) into public-facing web architectures
• Clients included Wellcare/Centene, Zing Health, Fleming's Steakhouse, Glory Days Grill, Metro Diner, Saddle Creek Logistics, Vulcan Materials, and BLR

Technologies: C#, .NET Core, React, Node.js, JavaScript, Azure, MySQL, WordPress/PHP

positions.title: Team Lead / .NET Developer
positions.description:
Built and maintained enterprise .NET services and operational applications; promoted to Team Lead to run a core service rewrite and infrastructure modernization.
• Led the migration of core web services from legacy WCF to ASP.NET Web API, replacing Windows authentication with OAuth 2.0, and managed inventory and deployment of all custom applications and dependencies into a new test environment
• Led the team converting client-side applications from WCF to Web API: Windows desktop applications, PowerShell scripts, .NET console applications, Windows services, and legacy VB6 applications
• Designed ASP.NET Core microservices with Autofac dependency injection and centralized Elasticsearch logging
• Built the Azure DevOps CI/CD pipeline that generates C# typed clients from OpenAPI descriptions with NSwag and publishes them to the internal Nexus NuGet repository
• Ran the scrum process (sprint planning, daily stand-up, review, retrospectives) through a multi-month enterprise rollout

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enterprise integrations, core business systems, and cloud-native applications for the company's sales, marketing, consulting, HR, finance, and partner-facing teams.
• Architected the migration of the monolithic web architecture to AWS Lambda services, dedicated API servers, and Amazon SQS for event-driven form submissions
• Built the ConnectWise Manage to QuickBooks Online invoice and payment integration for partners on AWS API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, and OAuth 2.0
• Built the connectwise.com to ConnectWise Manage lead-capture integration serving several hundred sales professionals, and the sync keeping several hundred thousand leads aligned between the custom lead administration system and Eloqua (Active Directory LDAP, custom REST frameworks)
• Integrated the NopCommerce-based marketplace (marketplace.connectwise.com) for license purchases and partner billing
• Built the channel-sales tracking application for resellers and distributors, and the scheduling application for internationally located onboarding and training consultants
• Integrated the UltiPro HR system with ConnectWise Manage and Active Directory to synchronize time-off requests and colleague information
